acceptance: site-parity check passes on a docs-touching PR
Docs and results sites agree on header shrink behavior
context:
Observed on PR #2688 (CI run 37361216876, site-parity job): header behaviour differs between docs and results for shrinkFocusOnToggle false vs true, in the page-chrome parity assertion. The PR touched only qualification code plus two markdown docs, so the failure is unrelated to its content — likely fallout from the Astro cutover work. site-parity is not a required check, so nothing is blocked, but it fails on any PR that triggers the site build.

Moved from the BenchBox core tracker on 2026-10-30, when this repository gained its own tracker.

Observed in core's site-parity CI job before the site moved out of core; core no longer builds the site. Check whether the header mismatch exists in this repository's build before working on it, and drop the item if it does not.
description: The site-parity CI job fails comparing docs-vs-results header behavior (shrinkFocusOnToggle false vs true) on PRs that trigger the site build, including PRs whose diff cannot affect site chrome. The mismatch needs a root cause and fix on the site side.
